ks-sos-2026-primary-vote-totals.agency: Kansas Secretary of State, Elections Division
ks-sos-2026-primary-vote-totals.title: 2026 Primary Election Official Vote Totals (August 4, 2026)
ks-sos-2026-primary-vote-totals.note: Statewide votes for every candidate on each party's primary ballot for 179 state offices. The totals give no count of other write-in votes, so shares are of the listed candidates' votes, as the totals print them; every printed percent was checked against the votes. The page prints no date; the file's own properties date it 2026-09-01. On 2026-09-30 the Secretary's results page had precinct workbooks for Congress only, so the state totals could not be checked against county sums. Congress and the constitutional amendment question are left to other pages.

ks-openstates-roster.title: Kansas legislators and statewide officials
ks-openstates-roster.note: Today's holder of each seat and office: names, party and seat only. The roster carries no Treasurer, Commissioner of Insurance, State Board of Education member or judge. A candidate is marked as the sitting member only when the name fits the holder of that seat and no other person in the race fits.
